events.text:
The catalog query returned 17 products with no sales in the last 90 days. That list is now with Sam Whitlock.

A catalog check also flagged an error from the 2026-10-14 increase. Twenty-two products marked as fixed-price contract items, P-1201 through P-1222, were raised by 3% when they should have been excluded. Eight orders since then, SO-77310 through SO-77317, were placed at the higher prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.

I have not changed any prices. Lena Ortiz has the same facts and a recommendation to restore the prior list prices and credit those orders. I am waiting for her confirmation before reversing anything.
